fixes.title: Lock in Burlington/Halton local discovery across profile + posts
fixes.whyItMatters: Local visibility scored 0, meaning Instagram has weak signals for Burlington/Halton buyers. Adding clear location + category signals increases who sees your content when people search or browse locally.
fixes.exactAction:
1) Edit Instagram display name to: "BotLogix - AI for Small Business | Burlington".
2) Update every post caption to include one local line near the end: "Serving small businesses in Burlington & Halton." (keep it natural).
3) Add location tags on every new post: "Burlington, ON" or "Halton" (choose one and stay consistent).
fixes.evidence: Local visibility dimension shows 0, with terms checked including burlington, halton, hamilton, greater toronto area—suggesting location signals aren’t currently translating into discoverability.

fixes.title: Create 2 pinned “how-to-buy/start” posts to convert better
fixes.whyItMatters: Sales readiness is 56/100; visitors likely understand what you do but don’t have an obvious next step. Pinned guides reduce friction and increase follower-to-lead conversion.
fixes.exactAction:
Create and pin these two posts:
Post 1 (carousel): "How to get AI workflows working for your business (7 steps)" with slides: 1) Pick a workflow (follow-up, lead capture, inbox, scheduling) 2) Map current steps 3) Choose the agent/tool 4) Set rules 5) Connect data 6) Test with real messages 7) Measure time saved.
Post 2 (reel or carousel): "What BotLogix does in your first week" with slides/frames: audit → workflow design → automation setup → follow-up messaging system → handoff + next steps.
Then pin both posts at the top of your profile and add a final line on each: "Learn more at botlogix.ca".
fixes.evidence: Sales readiness dimension scored 56/50 (profile converting but not fully ready), and competitor gap is strong—so a clearer purchase/start path should capture that attention.

fixes.title: Run a tight link-in-bio A/B test aligned to your best post type
fixes.whyItMatters: Profile conversion is 55. The link-in-bio is the bottleneck for turning interest into site visits/leads. A/B testing the destination and pinned-post order can quickly improve conversion without changing your posting cadence.
fixes.exactAction:
A/B test for 14 days:
Variant A: Link-in-bio points to https://botlogix.ca homepage.
Variant B: Link-in-bio points to the most relevant landing page on your site (if you have one for AI workflows/agents). If you don’t have separate pages, create a single new section page on your site titled "AI Workflows for Small Businesses" and link to that.
Also pin order:
- First pin: the best-performing format you currently have (carousel or reel—use what your insights show).
- Second pin: the other guide.
Keep everything else unchanged during the test.
fixes.evidence: Profile conversion dimension shows 55 and explicitly suggests A/B testing link-in-bio destination and pinned posts.

fixes.title: Adopt a signature content format that differentiates from competitors
fixes.whyItMatters: Competitor gap is 70, meaning you have room to win. A signature format makes your account instantly recognizable and improves saves/shares versus generic “AI tips.”
fixes.exactAction:
Launch a recurring series you can sustain:
Series name: "AI Workflow Fixes (Burlington/Halton Edition)".
Format per post (carousel, 6 slides):
1) The common problem (e.g., “Leads go cold after Instagram DM”).
2) What’s happening now.
3) The workflow (agent steps in plain language).
4) The exact follow-up messages (include 2-3 sample lines).
5) Time saved / benefit in business terms.
6) Where to start: "See examples at botlogix.ca".
Use the local audience line: "Built for small businesses in Burlington & Halton."
fixes.evidence: Competitor gap scored 70 with nextMove to differentiate with a signature format competitors don’t use.

fixes.title: Increase content depth without increasing posting frequency: optimize the next 2 posts
fixes.whyItMatters: Content performance is 50 and activity is low (about 0.2 posts/week). Since you’re already below market average, the highest leverage is improving per-post conversion and shareability—not simply posting more often.
fixes.exactAction:
For your next two posts, do this checklist:
1) Hook in first line (problem + outcome): “If your Instagram DMs aren’t turning into booked calls, here’s the workflow fix.”
2) Add an “Example outputs” section (show 2 example follow-up messages or a mini workflow diagram in text).
3) End with an intent-based, non-salesy line that drives to your site: “See workflow examples at botlogix.ca.”
4) Use consistent local phrasing: “for Burlington & Halton small businesses.”
5) Ensure captions are scannable (short paragraphs, 1 emoji per section max).
fixes.evidence: Content performance is 50, with recent posting volume around 0.23/week; the best lever is per-post effectiveness and share/saves, not frequency changes.
